omissions: Crystal Palace home defeat belongs as verified context for April title-race decline in the Everton report rather than another overlapping standalone defeat.
Southampton FA Cup youth victory and Fulham League Cup semi-final are contextual support for the Wembley team, not required separate reports.
Ordinary league wins and Europa League group/Sparta ties are omitted; no attempt is made to reproduce every fixture.
Atalanta second-leg win is covered as the aftermath of the damaging Anfield first leg.
limitations: Atalanta requires canonical opposition resolution by the coordinator.
PGMOL acknowledged the Diaz offside error; do not imply the sendings-off or ultimate result were reversed, and do not speculate about motives.
Fulham opener was an own goal by Bernd Leno following Alexander-Arnold free-kick; do not credit Alexander-Arnold with two goals.

Forest latest-winner record is explicitly limited to available Premier League timing records from 2006–07 onwards. The Premier League page title-race table now displays final standings; use dated narrative for matchday position.
Everton defeat badly damaged the title challenge but did not mathematically eliminate Liverpool that evening.
Chelsea final substitution times differ by one minute between club providers; use event-minute convention consistently or omit exact substitution times.
Full line-ups, exact times, detailed action and contextual claims need independent cross-checks during manuscript production. No footage reviewed.
No manuscript may begin until the coordinator confirms remote claims and chronological previous-season checkpoint.
